warrant: This check grades transformed-basis energy or terminal composition amounts. phase_diagram.py uses a 1e-11 formation-energy filter, 1e-8 numerical tolerance, Qhull facet construction and, for phase-separation optimization, SLSQP with default tolerance 1e-8. The approved bound is 1e-07 absolute plus 1e-7 relative in each reported quantity's units. The 1e-5 absolute optimization allowance follows the upstream inner-hull regression assertion; it is not a measured platform floor. Wrong energy normalization, missing phases or failed composition conservation must remain detectable. Decompositions are reduced to conserved composition, total weight and mixture energy to permit equivalent degenerate mixtures; moment-based collections do not uniquely determine every member. Fixed queries are keyed by input row, chemical identity or physical path position, never solver storage order. Native investigation and Docker calibration passed; the user approved these policies and bounds. Native nominal-versus-variant comparison passed with maximum bound fraction 2.34188e-09; this does not establish a cross-platform floor or replace human tolerance approval.
